Property.Label: Address assignment
Property.Description: Use DHCP or a static address.

Property.Label: IPv4 address
Property.Description: Ignored when the mode is dhcp.

Property.Label: Prefix length
Property.Description: Netmask in CIDR notation, for example 24.

Property.Label: Default gateway
Property.Description: Ignored when the mode is dhcp.

Property.Label: Hostname
Property.Description: Fully qualified name used in the generated certificate.

Property.Label: Organisation name
Property.Description: Shown throughout the application. Replaces the placeholder name carried by the reference database.

Property.Label: Administrator email
Property.Description: Login for the first administrator account. Its password is generated at first boot and shown on the VM console; it must be changed at first login.

Property.Label: Licence server URL
Property.Description: Optional. Set this to activate a licence online from the web console. Leave it empty for air-gapped deployments: the appliance then accepts a signed licence key pasted in by hand, and makes no outbound connection of any kind.
